verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Shop Sale CTA to a small pill crammed into the bottom-left corner beside illegible legal text, which buries the action and leaves a large dead band under the shoe. B keeps a prominent, centred CTA and a clean vertical flow. Its flaws: the headline runs into the circle, WEEKEND ONLY has moved from eyebrow to below the subhead, and the legal line is tiny.

A has a strong top-to-bottom flow and a large shoe. But '20% off' and the subhead collide with the peach circle, WEEKEND ONLY has lost its eyebrow role, and the legal text is tiny. B groups the headline, subhead, tag and CTA tightly, but the smaller shoe sits stranded on the circle above a roughly 100px empty gap, so the canvas feels split and bottom-heavy.

A shrinks the shoe and the Shop Sale button to tiny afterthoughts at the bottom edge. The CTA is illegible and the product is trivialised, the legal line floats on its own, and the middle is mostly empty. B keeps the product and CTA prominent, with the same minor flaws: the headline overlaps the circle and WEEKEND ONLY is demoted.

A puts the shoe up on the circle and stacks the text below it, but the shoe is small and a large dead gap opens between WEEKEND ONLY and the CTA. B keeps the shoe large and the spacing more even, though its headline crashes into the circle and the legal text is tiny.
